quotations.old_english: Lǽt ðé on gemyndum hú ðæt manegum wearþ fira gefrége
quotations.english: keep in thy mind how that was known among many men

source_text: ge-frége; adj. Known, celebrated, famous; n&o-long;tus, c&e-short;l&e-short;ber, f&a-long;m&o-long;sus :-- Lǽt ðé on gemyndum hú ðæt manegum wearþ fira gefrége keep in thy mind how that was known among many men, Andr. Kmbl. 1921; An. 963 : 2240; An. 1121. v. ge-frǽge; adj.
